thread:
elaine: RC v2.7.0-rc3 created. Artifact pinned: images/backend:2.7.0-rc3, api-proxy:1.4.0-rc2. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. Requesting sign-off and sheriffs for promo. release-notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/rl/RC-224
ben: quick q — is DB migration in this RC? I think we deferred it.
marta: no migration in this cut, it's a pure service/config change. Good for short promo.
elaine: can we confirm KV warm strategy? need to ensure no cold spikes.
ashley: plan is kv-warm on canaries + staged traffic. I'll kick off kv warm script.
ashley: running: ./scripts/kv-warm.sh --model-prefix=kv/v2.7 --concurrency=10
deploy-bot: Promo request received for 2.7.0-rc3. Running preflight checks...
deploy-bot: checks passed: build-signature, image-scan, smoke-tests
pj: oncall acked. I'll be monitor during promo. :eyes:
ben: +1 from ops — load tests looked fine at projected traffic
marta: docs changed? release notes look small; I added a line about routing policy defaults.
elaine: cool. signoff checklist: @pj oncall, @ben ops, @marta prod, and @ashley sre. please reply with :thumbsup: to proceed.
pj: :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
marta: :thumbsup:
ashley: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Locking release: pin tag applied backend@2.7.0-rc3
deploy-bot: Scheduling promo in 15m to start traffic canary (10%).
elaine: Promo window: start at 02:15 UTC. Canary 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full.
elaine: Rollback signal: if error rate > 0.8% or latency p95 regressed > 150ms for 3m, abort and roll back to 2.6.9
pj: noted. I'm watching error-rate dashboard and traces.
ashley: smoke hooks enabled: auto-rollback disabled (manual). We'll manually hit rollback if telemetry trips.
ben: I've prepped rollback command and tested it in staging:
ben: ```
./deploy rollback --service backend --to-tag 2.6.9 --force
```
marta: release notes link again: https://redwood.atlassian.net/rl/RC-224 — please review language on the 'routing defaults' paragraph
elaine: last call: anything blocking?
ben: nothing blocking from infra
pj: no blockers
marta: small wording nit; can fix post-promo if needed.
elaine: ok starting canary in 5m. I'll post updates here. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started. 10% traffic -> backend@2.7.0-rc3
(10m passes)
elaine: Canary steady. metrics look good. moving to 50% in 1m.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 50%.
ashley: p95 unchanged, error rate 0.03% currently.
pj: no alerts. proceeding.
elaine: shifting to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 100%. Promo complete. Congratulations :tada:
elaine: tagging release as promoted -> prod:2.7.0
elaine: post-promo notes: monitor for 30m; follow-up PR for docs tweak by marta. Thanks team!
pj: monitoring. all quiet so far.
ben: I'll run cost/latency baseline comparison in next hour and post results.
marta: will open docs PR in ~10m.
elaine: closing thread after 30m of quiet. great work. :clap:
